# Easy Statistics Academy

> Free bilingual (English–Arabic) statistics learning platform by Ammar Homaida, PhD in Statistics. Lessons cover descriptive statistics, probability, statistical inference (confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, classical tests, assumptions and robustness, power), modelling and mathematical statistics, with interactive labs whose numerical results are verified against SciPy and closed-form references.

- Website: {{ site.url }}/
- Arabic lessons index: {{ site.url }}/ar/
- Sitemap: {{ site.url }}/sitemap.xml
